settings:
!
! radiomicsj params
!
INT_label=1

# NEAREST_NEIGHBOR=0, NONE=0, BILINEAR=1, BICUBIC=2;
INT_interpolation2D=1
INT_interpolation_mask2D=1

# 3D Interpolation TRILINEAR=100, NEAREST=101, SPLINE=102
INT_interpolation3D=101
INT_interpolation_mask3D=101

# USE=1
BOOL_USE_FixedBinNumber=true

#DOUBLE_binWidth=25
INT_binCount=6
#BOOL_normalize=0
#BOOL_removeOutliers=1
#DOUBLE_zScore=3
#DOUBLE_normalizeScale=
#DOUBLE_densityShift=
#DOUBLE_rangeMax=400
#DOUBLE_rangeMin=-1000
#DOUBLEARRAY_resamplingFactorXYZ=1.0,1.0,1.0
BOOL_activate_no_default_features=true
#BOOL_force2D=0
!
!texture param
!
INT_alpha=0
INT_deltaGLCM=1
INT_deltaNGTDM=1
INT_deltaNGLDM=1
! Notice: STRING_weightingNorm: nothing or, "no_weighting", "manhattan", "euclidian", "infinity"
STRING_weightingNorm=
!
!IVH param
!
#INT_IVH_binCount=1000
#DOUBLE_IVH_binWidth=2.5
!IVH mode 0:No discretise (default), 1 binWidth, 2 binCount else back to defalut
INT_IVH_MODE=0
!
!Fractal param
!
INTARRAY_box_sizes=2,3,4,6,8,12,16,32,64
!
!Select calculating features
!
BOOL_enableOperationalInfo=1
BOOL_enableDiagnostics=1
BOOL_enableMorphological=1
BOOL_enableLocalIntensityFeatures=1
BOOL_enableIntensityBasedStatistics=1
BOOL_enableIntensityHistogram=1
BOOL_enableIntensityVolumeHistogram=1
BOOL_enableShape2D=0
BOOL_enableGLCM=1
BOOL_enableGLRLM=1
BOOL_enableGLSZM=1
BOOL_enableGLDZM=1
BOOL_enableNGTDM=1
BOOL_enableNGLDM=1
BOOL_enableFractal=1
#BOOL_enableHomological=0
rule: tolerance > 0: pass when |computed - reference| <= tolerance. No tolerance: the IBSI manual states neither a tolerance nor a rounding rule, so this library uses its own criterion (computed value and reference rounded half up to N = max(3, digits of the printed reference) significant digits are equal), counted separately from a pass. The relative 1%/20% rules of Validation.ibsiDigitalPhantom() are not used.
